name: Autocomplete For Woo Orders
author: Nilesh Kanzariya

sections.description:
Autocomplete For Woo Orders helps you automatically mark WooCommerce orders as Completed after payment — based on your rules.
Save time and reduce manual work by letting the plugin handle repetitive order processing.

Key Features

  • Smart Order Completion – Auto-complete orders based on product types, payment methods, and user roles
  • Product Type Support – Works with simple, grouped, virtual + downloadable products
  • Payment Method Integration – Compatible with all major gateways
  • User Role Management – Control which roles can trigger auto-completion
  • Thank You Messages – Show custom messages on order completion
  • Translation Ready – WPML compatible

Perfect for stores selling digital products, memberships, or subscriptions.

Notes

Supported Gateways

✅ PayPal
✅ Stripe
✅ Square
✅ Apple Pay
✅ Google Pay
✅ Amazon Pay
✅ Klarna
✅ Afterpay
✅ Venmo
✅ All other gateways that confirm successful payment

Not Supported

❌ Cash on Delivery
❌ Check Payment
❌ Bank Transfer

(Excluded for security reasons — unpaid orders should not be auto-completed.)

Helpful Tips

  • Lightweight: won’t slow down your site
  • Works with all WooCommerce themes
  • Ideal for digital goods, courses, or memberships
  • Combine rules, e.g. auto-complete digital products via Stripe for logged-in users

Summary

Autocomplete For Woo Orders gives you full control over how and when WooCommerce orders are completed — saving you time and reducing errors.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/autocomplete-for-woo-orders/
  2. Activate it through Plugins > Installed Plugins
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Smart Autocomplete
  4. Configure your rules (product types, user roles, payment gateways, etc.)
  5. Save — your orders will now auto-complete automatically
sections.faq:
Will this plugin auto-complete every order?

No. You control what gets auto-completed. Conditions can be set for product types, payment methods, and user roles.

Does it work with virtual and downloadable products?

Yes. WooCommerce already completes these by default — you can choose whether to apply rules here too.

Can I exclude payment methods like Cash on Delivery?

Yes. For security, unpaid gateways like Cash on Delivery, Check, and Bank Transfer are not supported.

Will it work with PayPal, Stripe, or Apple Pay?

Yes. It supports PayPal, Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, Klarna, Afterpay, Square, Venmo, and more.
